nodes.label: Mirai-AI-Web Project Context
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare Worker in workers/ plus frontend in frontend/ (built via scripts/build-frontend.mjs), TypeScript, SQL schemas in db/, android/ only for mobile tasks.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: A persistent knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships, queried before raw source browsing to return scoped subgraphs much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify update .
nodes.rationale: Run once after a set of code changes (not every small edit) to keep the graph current; AST-only so it carries no API cost.

nodes.label: Android Status Bar Theme Color
nodes.rationale: The theme-color meta controls the Android app status bar color; applyAppearance keeps it in sync with the active theme.
